title: [1.20 regression] incorrect reachability for comparisons between set and frozenset
author: hauntsaninja
body_preview: ``` def foo(x: frozenset[str], y: set[str]):     if x == y:         reveal_type(x) ``` With `--warn-unreachable` the reveal_type is marked as unreachable. This relates to new narrowing logic in mypy 1.20. An easy fix could be to mark frozenset as having a custom `__eq__`.
